answer: Unique-storage residency blocks sybils. Each epoch the ledger VRF-draws every identity's duty from a public chunk pool, the shard ocean: unique, revealed only at epoch start. Each identity holds its 32 GB shard live, serving random 1 MB ranges in 5 s when 9 committee members ask. A miss voids that epoch's earnings; two misses in 30 days freeze it 90 days. Shards admit no dedup or pre-farming, so n sybils pay n x 32 GB fresh storage - linear in n, at $0.20 per identity-epoch. Verdicts seal in a marble append-only log; the 30-day strike horizon blocks parallel-reset escapes.
